# nlohmann/json

Unmodified single-header distribution of **nlohmann/json v3.11.3**, licensed under
MIT (see `LICENSE.MIT`). Only the frontend JSON implementation and its tests use
this dependency; it is not part of the public headers. Configuration and builds
use the vendored copy and do not download it.
